policy: Mirror FOSS only when license allows. Proprietary firmware/apps = official manufacturer / store links only.
scope: RV · camper · Class A · light truck connectivity-first; light marine FOSS OK.

entries.title: VictronConnect
entries.summary: Configure, monitor, update, and diagnose Victron products (Bluetooth / VE.Direct / VE.Smart / Wi-Fi).

entries.title: Venus OS / GX
entries.summary: Official Venus OS / GX for Cerbo, Ekrano, and other GX devices — Victron-published builds only (no re-hosted .swu).

entries.title: VRM portal & app
entries.summary: Remote monitoring for GX devices — portal plus official VRM mobile apps.

entries.title: Peplink / Pepwave firmware & InControl
entries.summary: Official firmware + InControl. Field speak: bonding and/or failover (SpeedFusion) with Starlink + cellular.

entries.title: weBoost support
entries.summary: Official support. UMRT: weBoost Authorized Installer. Outdoor RF required; AGC — no invent-from-zero; we do not tune gain.

entries.title: weBoost app
entries.summary: Install guidance, tower aiming, before/after readings. Complements Authorized Installer placement — does not create signal from zero RF.

entries.title: weBoost support & Wilson resources
entries.summary: weBoost support plus Wilson Amplifiers resources. Same honesty: outdoor RF / AGC / no invent-from-zero.

entries.title: SureCall support & manuals
entries.summary: Vehicle/RV boosters — manufacturer only. Outdoor RF + separation. No UMRT SureCall cert title.

entries.title: SureCall app
entries.summary: Antenna aiming / separation on compatible boosters. Does not invent coverage from zero outdoor RF.

entries.title: Cel-Fi / Nextivity support
entries.summary: Official Nextivity/Cel-Fi support. Often one operator at a time (WAVE switch) — not simultaneous multi-carrier like weBoost. No UMRT Cel-Fi cert.

entries.title: CEL-FI WAVE app
entries.summary: Register, configure, monitor, update Cel-Fi (Bluetooth). Primary setup path — not a substitute for outdoor RF.

entries.title: CEL-FI MyWAVE app
entries.summary: Optional Follow-my-Phone utility for GO/ROAM Mobile Mode. Do not confuse with WAVE.

entries.title: KING Connect (legacy)
entries.summary: Do not sell new. Site returns 200 but is empty Shopify placeholder; deep support/manuals 404. Existing Extend → weBoost RV path. No KING cert title.

entries.title: Winegard support
entries.summary: ConnecT / ConnecT 5G = RV Wi-Fi + LTE router/hotspot (SIM), not a weBoost-class RF amp. Official Winegard only.

entries.title: Winegard RV Halo app
entries.summary: Official app for ConnecT / Halo (replaces ConnecTed). Setup/updates — not a cell-booster AGC tuner.

entries.title: Starlink app
entries.summary: Official app. Clear-sky installs; no Starlink Certified title.

entries.title: GL.iNet firmware downloads
entries.summary: Travel / 4G-5G routers common on coaches — official firmware CDN + support. Link only (not a FOSS mirror of proprietary images).

entries.title: Teltonika Networks wiki
entries.summary: Industrial / fleet cellular routers used on RVs and light trucks — official wiki + site. No redistributed vendor packages.

entries.title: Dometic mobile apps
entries.summary: Official Dometic apps — store search / manufacturer site only (no guessed App Store IDs).

entries.title: Signal K Server
entries.summary: Open marine/RV data server — pin release + SHA256 before mirroring.

entries.title: Node-RED
entries.summary: Low-code flow automation (common with Signal K / marine-RV dashboards). Pin release + SHA256 before mirroring; official nodered.org / docs / npm / github only.

entries.title: OpenWrt
entries.summary: Open router OS (often under travel routers). Mirror only official release images with checksum — never vendor-locked forks without license clarity.

entries.title: Victron manuals & tech docs
entries.summary: Official manuals, live wiki, and technical information - manufacturer portals only.

entries.title: Victron Toolkit
entries.summary: Cable size / voltage drop, Multi & Quattro LED codes, and inverter derating — official store apps only.

entries.title: VEConfigure / VE.Bus tools
entries.summary: VEConfigure 3, Quick Configure, System Configurator, and VEFlash — download from Victron only (we do not host installers).

entries.title: VE Power Setup
entries.summary: Firmware updates for VE.Can products (Skylla-i, Lynx Shunt VE.Can, interfaces) — Victron installer only.

entries.title: Peplink support & forum
entries.summary: Official support + firmware downloads + community forum. Field: bonding and/or failover (SpeedFusion).

entries.title: Starlink support
entries.summary: Official Starlink support hub. Clear-sky installs; no invented Starlink Certified title.

entries.title: Dometic support
entries.summary: Official Dometic support portal + store app search. Link only.

entries.title: Node-RED flows library
entries.summary: Official Node-RED flow library. Review each flow before use; UMRT helps integrate - we don't ship unvetted community flows as product.

entries.title: Node-RED Dashboard (classic)
entries.summary: Classic Node-RED UI dashboard nodes — pin release + SHA256 before any mirror; official GitHub only.

entries.title: OpenWrt Firmware Selector
entries.summary: FOSS router OS — use Firmware Selector for exact device; verify checksums. Replacing vendor FW is brick-risk.

entries.title: Teltonika firmware wiki downloads
entries.summary: Industrial/fleet cellular — model FW on official wiki only. No Teltonika partner title.

entries.title: GL.iNet router docs
entries.summary: Travel router docs + official CDN. Vendor images proprietary even if OpenWrt-derived — link only. No GL partner title.

entries.title: Cradlepoint NetCloud
entries.summary: Enterprise WWAN class. Modern NCOS via NetCloud Manager + subscription — no offline NCOS myth. No Cradlepoint partner title. UMRT multi-WAN cert story remains Peplink.

entries.title: Semtech / Sierra AirLink
entries.summary: AirLink RV50X/RV55-class. Firmware via The Source; manage with ALMS. No Sierra partner title; not Peplink SpeedFusion.

entries.title: Starlink plans (Residential / Roam)
entries.summary: Residential ≠ travel. Roam = RV/nomad; don't oversell nationwide in-motion. Install capability only — never Starlink Certified.

entries.title: Starlink bypass mode
entries.summary: Third-party router / Peplink path — official bypass docs only. No proprietary firmware hacks.

entries.title: Starlink specifications
entries.summary: Hardware specs for power sizing honesty (Mini vs Flat/HP draw). Official Starlink only.
